card.name: Words leading into 'shed light' or 'shine'
card.fires_on: Words in press-release or advocacy text where the next word could plausibly be 'shine' or 'shed', as in 'shed light on' or 'shine a spotlight on'. Often a subject noun or 'to' or 'will' just before a verb of highlighting.

modes.label: Event or report as subject
modes.description: A noun such as side event or forum, or the verb shines, in a sentence saying what an event or report does.
modes.example: This<< side>> event is co-sponsored by the Permanent Miss

modes.label: Purpose words before a verb
modes.description: Small words like to, will or have that come before a verb saying what an initiative aims to do.
modes.example: The initiative is designed<< to>> encourage women to talk to their healthcare providers

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like shine and shed, as in 'shed light on' and 'shine a spotlight'.
card.plain: It fires in advocacy writing where a report or event is about to be said to shed light on an issue.
